nodes.label: ui_screens
nodes.description: Module "ui_screens" of a chess_game_2 app. Implement this module's responsibility end-to-end — the rest of the app's modules are separate files. Data contracts: core_engine → ui_screens (requests).

nodes.label: core_engine
nodes.description: Module "core_engine" of a chess_game_2 app. Implement this module's responsibility end-to-end — the rest of the app's modules are separate files. Data contracts: core_engine → ui_screens (requests); core_engine → input_handler (results).

nodes.label: input_handler
nodes.description: Module "input_handler" of a chess_game_2 app. Implement this module's responsibility end-to-end — the rest of the app's modules are separate files. Data contracts: core_engine → input_handler (results); input_handler → data_store (state_and_events).

nodes.label: data_store
nodes.description: Module "data_store" of a chess_game_2 app. Implement this module's responsibility end-to-end — the rest of the app's modules are separate files. Data contracts: input_handler → data_store (state_and_events); data_store → game_engine (data).

nodes.label: game_engine
nodes.description: Module "game_engine" of a chess_game_2 app. Implement this module's responsibility end-to-end — the rest of the app's modules are separate files. Data contracts: data_store → game_engine (data).
